standard: Year-normalisation standard: 5 needs a baseline-anchored delivered-cargo number; 4 is a novel platform/chemistry concretely relevant to loading or uptake; 3 is mechanistic insight or conventional targeted carrier; ties break down.

articles.title: Click-Chemistry Functionalized Lipid Nanoparticles for In Vitro and In Vivo Transfection of Primary Human CD4+ T Cells.
articles.rationale: Modular DBCO-azide conjugation of a CD4 nanobody to LNPs with in vivo selective human CD4+ T cell transfection in humanized mice is a novel nanobody-carrier platform, but the 48% and 32% figures measure transfection/editing rather than delivered cargo, so not 5.

articles.title: Supramolecular Pretargeting Lipid Nanoparticles Based on Host-Guest Recognition Potentiate Cancer Immunotherapy by Reprogramming Tumor Microenvironment.
articles.rationale: Pre-dosed ADA-anti-PD-L1 antibody capturing CB[7]-LNPs by host-guest chemistry is a new two-step antibody-primed delivery format aimed at intratumoral retention and uptake, with no accumulation number in the abstract.

articles.title: Bevacizumab-Functionalized Exosome-Associated Chitosan Nanocomposite for Temozolomide Delivery and Apoptosis-Related Transcriptional Modulation in Experimental Glioma.
articles.rationale: Antibody-functionalised exosome/chitosan carrier with reported loading (15.96 wt%) and retained VEGF binding (74.9%) but no biodistribution, no untargeted control, and the abstract itself defers PK, so no antibody-specific delivery insight; low 3.

articles.title: Rituximab-Conjugated DART Nanoformulation for CD20-Targeted Drug Delivery in Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma.
articles.rationale: Greater CD20-dependent cellular association of RTX-DART than IgG-DART with blocking control is an antibody-attributable uptake gain, but unquantified in the abstract on a conventional PLGA-PEG nanoparticle, so a 3 not a 4.

articles.title: Trastuzumab deruxtecan kills skin and uveal melanoma in vivo by HER2-independent payload release
articles.rationale: Preprint. Shows low trastuzumab uptake and extracellular cathepsin L cleavage of the T-DXd linker releasing payload outside the cell, a mechanistic ADC payload-release insight usable for linker design, though efficacy-framed.

articles.title: Dual-targeted nanoparticles enable the ex vivo generation of cytotoxic and phagocytic CAR effector cells
articles.rationale: Preprint. New anti-CD222 antibody (an internalising receptor) co-displayed with anti-CD5 on LNPs substantially enhanced CAR mRNA delivery versus non-conjugated LNPs, a concrete antibody-attributable gain, but no fold figure in the abstract.

articles.title: Nanobody-Functionalized AAV achieves Promoter-independent Neuronal Targeting in the CNS
articles.rationale: Preprint. Nanobody-displaying AAV gives an 8-fold higher proportion of transduced neurons than wild-type at equal titre, but this is a cell-fraction expression readout on a viral vector, not delivered cargo, so ties down to 3.

articles.title: Catamers: Multi-specific therapeutics that concatenate individual warheads on a DNA scaffold via Watson-Crick interactions
articles.rationale: Preprint. Abstract states a concept with only molecular simulations, a PSMA-binding peptide rather than an antibody or nanobody, and no delivery measurement, so off-thesis.
